page_title: LIV 1-1 ARS | Liverpool v Arsenal 23/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+1' A yellow card is awarded to Ben White (Arsenal).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Referee Chris Kavanagh sees the trip by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
86' A yellow-coloured card is received by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
85' A dangerous looking corner kick from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is cleared to safety by the defence.
84' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
84' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
83' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:2.
82' PENALTY APPEAL after Kai Havertz (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
80' Arsenal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
78' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Gabriel Jesus is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
75' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
75' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

75' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) squanders a clear opportunity to score. He was one-on-one with David Raya on the edge of the box and attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but was denied by a terrific save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
73' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
72' The corner is swung in but Arsenal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luis Diaz departs the field of play to be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
68' Substitution. Cody Gakpo makes way for Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch so that Gabriel Martinelli can be given a rest.
68' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) replaces Curtis Jones.
65' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
65' The Arsenal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
62' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
60' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
58' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
52' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
49' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
47' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) will miss the next game.
45+4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+3' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

41' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
39' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
37' Now Liverpool have a corner.
37' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is intercepted by Alisson.
35' Jurgen Klopp is forced to make a change. Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Joe Gomez.
34' The injury to Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
33' Chris Kavanagh couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) and blew his whistle.

29' 1 - 1 Goal! Trent Alexander-Arnold finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the top right corner. Fantasy football! 1:1.
27' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
26' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' 53:47 – the latest ball possession ratio.
20' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
17' The ball possession at the moment is 67:33.
16' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
14' A rebound spins to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
14' An attempted cross from Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) is cleared.
12' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:2.
11' Liverpool earn a corner.
11' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
8' Looks like Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
6' Chris Kavanagh sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
5' The Arsenal players halt their celebrations as referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
4' 0 - 1 Gabriel (Arsenal) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 0:1.
3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick, but Alisson reads it well and stops the effort.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Arsenal will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
